name: facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructures/deprecated/batchers/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.run_acquire_slot: run the agent to fill one slot in the SlottedTemporalBuffer and write observations and states
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.run_acquire_episodes: run the agent across all environments until done and collect all slot assignments per env
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.review_acquire_slot: review the acquire_slot function that steps the agent through the environment and writes transitions to buffer slots
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.review_acquire_episodes: review the acquire_episodes function that resets the environment and loops acquire_slot until all envs finish
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.refactor_acquire_slot: refactor the acquire_slot function to support async environment stepping or batched buffer writes

facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.create_localbuffer: create a LocalBuffer instance with n_slots, s_slots, and specs for agent state, output, and environment
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.get_free_slots: get k available free slots from the LocalBuffer for writing new trajectory data
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.write_to_buffer: write variables into specified slots of the LocalBuffer at the current position_in_slot index
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.get_single_slots: retrieve data from single slots as a TemporalDictTensor with optional erase to free slots
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.get_multiple_slots: retrieve and concatenate data from multiple trajectories as a TemporalDictTensor with optional erase

facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.create_EpisodeBatcher: create an EpisodeBatcher with n_timesteps, n_slots, agent factory, env factory, and thread count
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.execute_MultiThreadEpisodeBatcher: execute the MultiThreadEpisodeBatcher to distribute n_episodes across worker threads with agent and env info
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.get_MultiThreadEpisodeBatcher: get collected episode data from the MultiThreadEpisodeBatcher buffer with optional blocking behavior
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.run_MonoThreadEpisodeBatcher: run a MonoThreadEpisodeBatcher to collect episode trajectories from a single-threaded agent and environment
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.update_EpisodeBatcher: update all worker agents in the EpisodeBatcher with new training info

facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.create_ThreadWorker: create a ThreadWorker instance that spawns a multiprocessing worker process for RL environment and agent management
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.acquire_episodes_ThreadWorker: acquire episodes from the worker by sending episode count, agent info, and env info through the input queue
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.reset_ThreadWorker: reset the worker process environment and agent state by sending a reset order with optional agent and env info
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.update_worker_ThreadWorker: update the worker agent parameters by sending update info through the input queue and waiting for confirmation
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.close_ThreadWorker: close the worker process by sending a close order, terminating the process, and cleaning up input and output queues

facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.create_Batcher: create a Batcher instance with n_timesteps, n_slots, agent factory, env factory, n_threads, and seeds
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.execute_Batcher: execute the Batcher by calling execute to acquire slots across all worker threads
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.get_Batcher: get completed trajectory slots from the Batcher buffer with optional blocking behavior
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.reset_Batcher: reset all worker threads in the Batcher with new agent_info and env_info DictTensors
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlstructur.update_Batcher: update all worker threads in the Batcher by passing new info to each worker
